jamaica.ex: Sandals (six adults-only resorts), Secrets, Breathless, Excellence Oyster Bay, Beaches Negril and Ocho Rios, Royalton Blue Waters, Hyatt Ziva/Zilara Rose Hall

rivieramaya.ex: Secrets, Breathless, Excellence, Zoetry, Hideaway at Royalton, Hyatt Ziva, Hard Rock, Moon Palace, Grand Palladium, Barcelo Maya, Iberostar

punta-cana.ex: Excellence, Secrets Cap Cana, Breathless, Zoetry Agua, Royalton, Hyatt Ziva, Hard Rock, Dreams, Barcelo Bavaro, Riu, Iberostar, Be Live

los-cabos.ex: Secrets Puerto Los Cabos, Breathless Cabo, Dreams Los Cabos, Hyatt Ziva Los Cabos, Riu Palace, Pueblo Bonito, Grand Fiesta Americana

bahamas.ex: Sandals Royal Bahamian and Emerald Bay (Exuma), Breezes, Riu Palace Paradise Island, Baha Mar (not all-inclusive)

barbados.ex: Sandals Barbados and Royal Barbados, Turtle Beach, Almond Beach

turks-caicos.ex: Beaches Turks and Caicos, Club Med Turkoise, Ocean Club West

aruba.ex: Riu Palace Antillas (adults-only), Riu Palace Aruba, Divi Aruba All Inclusive, Occidental, Hilton (packages)

canaries.ex: Many adults-only and family 4-star hotels in Tenerife, Gran Canaria and Fuerteventura (Riu, Iberostar, Lopesan, Barcelo, H10)

mallorca.ex: Alcudia, Cala Millor, Cala d'Or and Playa de Muro adults-only and family all-inclusive hotels (Iberostar, Riu, Zafiro, Viva)

algarve.ex: Vilamoura and Albufeira all-inclusive hotels (Vila Gale, Pestana, Dom Pedro), golf resorts

egypt.ex: Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurghada all-inclusive resorts (Rixos, Steigenberger, Jaz, Sunrise, Titanic)

mauritius.ex: Beachcomber, Lux, Constance, Paradise Cove (adults-only), Shandrani, Veranda, Sugar Beach (all-inclusive is the norm)

maldives.ex: Island resorts that are full-board or all-inclusive: Hideaway Beach (adults-only), Kuredu, Sun Siyam, Constance Halaveli, Soneva, Cocoon

fiji.ex: Likuliku Lagoon (adults-only), Tokoriki, Fiji Marriott, Outrigger Beach, Yasawa island resorts

seychelles.ex: Constance Ephelia and Lemuria, Kempinski (full board), few true all-inclusive resorts

borabora.ex: Overwater resorts sell all-inclusive packages rather than being all-inclusive resorts (Bora Bora Pearl Beach, Club Med Moorea)

colombian-caribbean.ex: Decameron Cartagena, Baru and San Andres, Hotel Las Americas

puerto-rico.ex: Few all-inclusives: El Conquistador, Royal Isabela (packages)

thailand.ex: Phuket and Khao Lak all-inclusive packages (Club Med Phuket, Dusit Thani Krabi, Katathani)

bali.ex: Nusa Dua all-inclusive resorts (Club Med Bali, Hard Rock Bali, Grand Mirage)

okinawa.ex: Resort hotels sell all-inclusive packages (Club Med Kabira, Hilton Okinawa Chatan)

belize.ex: Small island and jungle lodges with all-inclusive rates (Hamanasi, Placencia packages)

tanzania.ex: Safari lodges priced all-inclusive; excluded by the definition (the stay is excursions, not the property)
